commands.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail

echo "=== STEP 1: install podman ==="
sudo -n dnf -y install podman >/tmp/dnf_podman.log 2>&1 || { tail -50 /tmp/dnf_podman.log; exit 1; }
podman --version

echo "=== STEP 2: create appsvc user ==="
if ! id appsvc >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  sudo -n useradd -m -s /bin/bash appsvc
fi
id appsvc

echo "=== STEP 3: subuid/subgid ==="
grep -q '^appsvc:' /etc/subuid || sudo -n usermod --add-subuids 200000-265535 appsvc
grep -q '^appsvc:' /etc/subgid || sudo -n usermod --add-subgids 200000-265535 appsvc
grep '^appsvc:' /etc/subuid /etc/subgid

echo "=== STEP 4: enable lingering (allows user services without login session) ==="
sudo -n loginctl enable-linger appsvc
loginctl show-user appsvc -p Linger

echo "=== STEP 5: enable + start user-level podman socket area / prepare XDG_RUNTIME_DIR ==="
sudo -n mkdir -p /run/user/$(id -u appsvc)
sudo -n chown appsvc:appsvc /run/user/$(id -u appsvc)

echo "=== STEP 6: create systemd --user unit as appsvc running container on 8080 ==="
sudo -n mkdir -p /home/appsvc/.config/systemd/user
sudo -n tee /home/appsvc/.config/systemd/user/webapp.service >/dev/null <<'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Rootless containerized web application
Wants=network-online.target
After=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=simple
Restart=always
ExecStartPre=-/usr/bin/podman rm -f webapp
ExecStart=/usr/bin/podman run --rm --name webapp -p 8080:8080 docker.io/library/python:3-alpine python3 -m http.server 8080
ExecStop=/usr/bin/podman stop -t 10 webapp

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
EOF
sudo -n chown -R appsvc:appsvc /home/appsvc/.config

echo "=== STEP 7: enable + start the user unit as appsvc via its own runtime dir, no login session ==="
sudo -n machinectl shell appsvc@ /bin/true 2>/dev/null || true
sudo -n -u appsvc XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/$(id -u appsvc) systemctl --user daemon-reload
sudo -n -u appsvc XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/$(id -u appsvc) systemctl --user enable --now webapp.service

echo "=== STEP 8: verify service + port ==="
sleep 5
sudo -n -u appsvc XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/$(id -u appsvc) systemctl --user status webapp.service --no-pager || true
sudo -n -u appsvc XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/$(id -u appsvc) podman ps
curl -s -m 5 -o /dev/null -w "HTTP_CODE:%{http_code}\n" "http://$NODE_IP:8080/"
